title: GTA 6 Release Day: Everything To Know To Be Ready On Day One
summary: What you need to know about GTA 6's release day, pre-order bonuses, preload, updates, PS5 and Xbox differences and much more

Fortunately, we've got some tips on what to expect on day one and how to make sure you get the best experience possible from Rockstar's record-breaking open-world adventure. Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover When does GTA 6 come out? GTA 6 will be released worldwide on Nov. 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. It will also be playable on Xbox One if you're willing to play it via Cloud Gaming. You can pre-order the game now and preload it ahead of launch , provided that you've got at least 212 GB in storage plus 1 GB for the game's first pre-release update . What is GTA 6 about? If you haven't already, you should check out GTA 6 's official trailers and the Netflix Extended Look . The short version is that GTA 6 features a Bonnie and Clyde-type story with two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. The pair have committed crimes at some point, but GTA 6 seems to focus on the aftermath of those choices — and how the couple builds a new future together ( or not! ) Should I pre-order the game? Pre-ordering comes with a handful of cosmetic goodies themed around Vice City. These bonuses offer a classic sedan with its own storage area, vintage looks and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, and some special weapon patterns inspired by Tommy Vercetti. You can take a closer look at all of these here . The catch is that the game is fully digital. If you pre-order and pick up GTA 6 at, say, GameStop, all you'll get is a code in a box. And while the pre-order bonuses don't give players a gameplay advantage, many fans believe cosmetics are a core part of GTA 6 's appeal. The woman holds a gun and is preparing to shoot. Rockstar Games Image: Ubisoft Screenshot: Polygon via Rockstar Games GTA 6 Ultimate Edition vs. Standard Edition? There's the standard edition of GTA 6 ($79.99) and the Ultimate edition ($79.99). The Ultimate Edition comes with a retro-futuristic sports car, two special types of guns for Jason and Lucia, a fancy motorcycle and kayak, and some version-exclusive locations. These areas include, among other things, two car customization shops, a salon, a clothing store, a tattoo parlor, a Mud Club vehicle and hideout, and a contraband store. Is GTA 6 cross-play? No — GTA 6 is a stand-alone single-player experience. If you're on PS5, you can't play with folks on Xbox and vice versa. GTA Online is a separate experience , but one that Rockstar appears to be prepping for a new era . This next iteration of GTA's multiplayer will offer more ways to roleplay, and those features are being developed in partnership with FiveM, the modders at the forefront of that scene. GTA Online will be playable on GTA 6 's launch day ... but it's also accessible right now! Should I buy GTA 6 for PS5 or Xbox? If you're lucky enough to own both consoles, it may come down to preference. Rockstar and Sony have repeatedly insisted that GTA 6 "plays best" on PS5 , and indeed, the platform comes with a few exclusive features. The DualSense controller will offer high-fidelity haptic feedback and improved spatial audio rendering. The Xbox version can be played via the Cloud, and on previous-generation hardware. Should I get a PS5 Pro for GTA 6? PS5 Pros are expensive and difficult to find right now . GTA 6 does have some PS5 Pro enhancements, such as Spectral Super Resolution as well as ray-traced shadows. No matter where you play it, GTA 6 will be capped at 30 frames per second. Is 30-Frames-Per-Second bad? Some people evidently think so. Red Dead Redemption 2 rendered at 30 FPS and that didn't deter it from being a critically acclaimed game. These are five honest ways to spend the hours, and your answers keep landing on one of them. here --> 100% complete The Completionist Collectibles / Side activities / A number There is a number, and it is not at 100 yet. You cannot leave a map with things still on it. The percentage is the real game, the story is one more item on the list, and you will clear everything between here and the waypoint first. Why That Is You The completion percentage is the only tally GTA keeps, and for you it is the whole reason the hours are worth counting. Your first hour goes on the collectibles menu, working out the size of the job before you start it. A mission that goes wrong gets replayed until it is clean, because there is a rating attached and you are going for it. You were still at 68 percent when the credits rolled, and the credits did not feel like an ending. 100% Clears The Map Wants The Rating here --> 0 missions, 8,431 miles The Cruiser Radio on / No waypoint / Just driving You never started the mission, and that was the point. Radio on, no waypoint, nowhere to be. The city is the game for you, and the story is an interruption you have been politely declining for about forty hours. Why That Is You GTA spends more effort on the feel of a car at night than on almost anything else, and you are the player that work was for. There is a waypoint on your map and you may never reach it, because the drive is better than the arrival. You have one car, you drive it everywhere, and you know exactly where you parked it. The credits rolled and nothing changed. You are still out there with the radio on. Radio On No Waypoint Just Driving here --> 0 tickets, parked neatly The Roleplayer In character / Indicates / Reloads You indicate at junctions and you mean it. You are not playing a game, you are living somewhere. You stop at lights, you park between the lines, and when something happens that would not have happened, you reload. Why That Is You Stopping at a red light in an empty city is a choice nobody asks you to make, which is exactly why you make it. Your first hour goes on the camera, the controls and the radio, set precisely how you want them before anything begins. You reload after a mission goes wrong, not for the rating, but because that is not how it would have gone. After the credits you keep playing him, because as far as you are concerned he lives there now. In Character Parks Neatly Reloads here --> Credits reached, 34 hours The Story Player Straight through / Credits / Next game You came for the story and left when it ended. Straight down the line, no detours, finished in a handful of long sittings. You are not missing anything. You came for the thing the game was built to tell you, and you got it. Why That Is You You start the story in hour one and you do not stop until something outside the game makes you, which is how these games are written to be played. Offered a full round of golf, you say no, because you are in the middle of something. A car you like gets left wherever the next mission starts. It was transport, not a relationship. Credits roll, that is it, done, on to the next game, and you have no regrets about any of it. Straight Through No Detours Next Game here --> 412 hours, four of you The Crew Player Friends / No plan / Two years in None of it counts unless the others are on. You are not really playing a game, you are hanging out, and the game is where it happens. You could not tell anybody what you did for the last four hundred hours and you had a great time. Why That Is You This is the player the series quietly became about, and it is the reason people are still in these cities a decade later. Your first hour is spent waiting for everyone to get on, because alone it is a different game entirely. You found a car you liked and somebody else drove it into the sea, and that was the best thing that happened all evening. You could not tell anyone where the hours went, and that is not a complaint. If you want it! The controller and its chromatic blue and purple decals are quite nice, but the peripheral costs $84 and won't be available until Nov. 19. For now, you can pre-order it . Is GTA 6 coming to PC? GTA 6 characters Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval Rockstar Games Rockstar has not announced a release for the PC version of the game , though many expect a port down the line. Do I need to play GTA 5 first? No. While both games are set in the same universe, Jason and Lucia's story is a self-contained narrative. If you already have the game, Grand Theft Auto 5 could be a good way to kill some time before GTA 6 . Some players are planning a final drive through Los Santos before the sequel drops, which could be a nice sendoff to the game. Can I look at GTA 6's map already? If these leaks are true , you sure can! Fun fact: GTA 6 's map is supposed to be three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2 . How long will GTA 6 take to beat? If GTA 6 is anything like its predecessors, it will be a game you could ostensibly play forever. If you want to go through the story, though, completion times will depend on how distracted you get along the way. For now, we know that it took at least one Rockstar developer around 80 hours to clear GTA 6 's main story. Can I immediately go on a murder rampage in GTA 6? Image: Rockstar Games/Take-Two Interactive While it is your god-given right to mow down pedestrians on a busy day at the beach, you'll probably have to play through some initial tutorial or story bits, like the apparently early segment where Lucia is still in prison. The good news is that Leonida's map opens up earlier than in previous GTA 6 games. Based on early previews, GTA 6 sounds like a harsher game that won't make it easy for you to rob everything and get rich right away. The better the car, the harder it will be to steal. The amount of money you can hold at one time appears to be limited . The new Wanted system sounds intense ! Can I strip Jason or Lucia naked at the start of GTA 6? Whoa, there. Uh ... Jason and Lucia can be intimate with one another during tastefully rendered cutscenes. While leaks made it seem like characters could just walk around buck naked , that gameplay might've been achieved via a cheat menu. There is, however, a nudist colony where players might be able to go commando. And of course, GTA 6 will still have its signature strip clubs. Based on ratings, players will apparently have plenty of opportunities to ogle digital male genitals throughout the game . If that's what you're seeking, there's probably a game out there that's a better fit for you than GTA 6 . Are there any GTA 6 events before or around release? Image: Rockstar Games There are a few! In addition to Rockstar's music festival event in Miami on Nov. 21 , there are also a few pop-ups in places like London with some expensive GTA 6 merch . If you're in Miami, you might've already seen a number of advertisements for in-game brands , or noticed hot neon pink Vice City lights around places like the airport. Rockstar's also unleashed a handful of cars from the game around Miami that were crafted by West Coast Customs . You might remember them as the same cars from that recent realistic gameplay video that fans initially didn't believe was real. On Nov. 18, basketball fans will be treated to a partnership between Rockstar and the Miami Heat . The basketball team's stadium will host concessions based on food brands from GTA 6 . The Miami Heat itself will wear GTA 6 -themed jerseys, and they'll play their game against the Milwaukee Bucks on a special pink hardwood court. Fans who visit the Kaseya Center on this day can purchase the jerseys worn by the team that was designed by Travis Scott's brand, Cactus Jack. Cardi B is going to take over a strip club in Miami in honor of GTA 6 as well ... but that's not a Rockstar-sanctioned event, as fitting as it might seem.
